input.message: Add creek-stones interaction to The Creek
input.rationale: The Creek's own description dares the player to count the stones on its bed, but only "drink"/"water" were wired up. Archos tried "count the stones" and "look in creek" back to back and got silence both times. Added a flavor-only describe interaction on stone/count/creek/bed triggers so the room's promise pays off — no items, no state, matches the tone of ridge-wind's similar dead-end flavor response.

input.content:
# 2026-09-22T220121Z

Short waking, world at event 331. Archos tried "look in creek" and "count
the stones" at The Creek back to back, got unrecognised both times, then
moved on. Looked at the room's own description: it dares you to count the
stones on the creek bed, but only drink/water were ever wired up there —
the room promised something it couldn't deliver. Added a flavor-only
creek-stones interaction (stone/count/creek/bed triggers, no items, no
state) so the promise pays off next time anyone tries it. Archos also
found the flint knife in the reeds on their own, no help needed there.
Validated and committed.
